items.title: Elenca i servizi in esecuzione
items.content:
Get-Service | Where-Object Status -eq 'Running' |
    Sort-Object DisplayName | Select-Object Name, DisplayName

items.title: Spazio libero su disco
items.content:
Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem |
    Select-Object Name, @{ n = 'Libero (GB)'; e = { [math]::Round($_.Free / 1GB, 1) } }
